beats.line: What if you got $1 every time someone said AI?
beats.say: What if you got one dollar every time someone said A I?
beats.set: the hero sitting on a sofa in a small apartment scrolling his phone, empty wallet on the coffee table, close shot

beats.line: Day 1. A podcast plays in the background. $14.
beats.say: Day one. A podcast plays in the background. Fourteen dollars.
beats.set: the hero cooking in a small kitchen with a podcast playing from a speaker, a few dollar bills floating out of the speaker, close shot

beats.say: Day two. You go to one tech meetup.
beats.set: a crowded tech meetup room with a presenter on stage and slides, the hero in the audience as dollar bills rain down on him, other attendees confused, medium shot

beats.line: Week 1. Your friends start saying it on purpose. They want a cut.
beats.say: Week one. Your friends start saying it on purpose. They want a cut.
beats.set: the hero at a cafe table surrounded by grinning friends leaning in and holding out open palms, a stack of cash in front of him, medium shot

beats.line: Week 3. Your bank freezes your account. Suspicious activity.
beats.say: Week three. Your bank freezes your account. Suspicious activity.
beats.set: the hero at a bank counter while a stern bank clerk slides a 'frozen' sign across, a giant padlock around a vault behind them, medium shot

beats.line: Month 2. Earnings season. Every CEO says it 80 times per call.
beats.say: Month two. Earnings season. Every C E O says it eighty times per call.
beats.set: the hero at a desk wearing headphones in front of several monitors showing executives in suits on video calls, a money counting machine running next to him, medium shot

beats.line: Month 6. The tax office has a team just for you.
beats.say: Month six. The tax office has a whole team just for you.
beats.set: a grey tax office with a long table of serious tax officers with stacks of paper all staring at the hero sitting alone at the other end, wide shot

beats.line: Year 1. Companies start saying machine learning to avoid paying you.
beats.say: Year one. Companies start saying machine learning, just to avoid paying you.
beats.set: aerial shot of a city business district at sunset with glass towers, giant billboards being repainted, the hero tiny on a rooftop looking unimpressed, wide shot

beats.line: Year 3. 3 governments try to ban the word.
beats.say: Year three. Three governments try to ban the word.
beats.set: aerial shot of a grand parliament building with a crowd of protesters holding blank signs and politicians on the steps at a podium, the hero tiny in the crowd, golden hour, epic wide shot

beats.line: Year 10. You're a billionaire. You still can't explain what AI is.
beats.say: Year ten. You're a billionaire. You still can't explain what A I is.
beats.set: the hero sitting alone on a huge modern balcony at night over a glowing city, holding a glass, slightly lost, intimate close shot
